Type System & Interface Centralization Analysis

Date: 2025-01-07 Analysis: Complete inventory of abstract types, concrete types, and interface signatures in Powerful.jl

Executive Summary

Verdict: HIGHLY CENTRALIZED ✅

  • 66% of abstract types are in foundation/ (interface layer)
  • 100% of core interface signatures defined in foundation/
  • Clean separation: Foundation defines, Models implement, Solvers consume
  • Well-prepared for splitting into PowerfulBase.jl + Powerful.jl

2. Core Interface Functions

Primary Model Interface (foundation/)

Defined in: src/foundation/model_metadata.jl

# Interface declaration (line 45-48)
function model_metadata(model::Type)
    error("No `model_metadata` function defined for model $model. ...")
end

# Convenience wrapper (line 72-75)
function model_metadata(model_vec::AbstractModel)
    base_type = get_base_model_type(model_vec)
    return model_metadata(base_type)
end

# Residual calculation interface (line 78-99)
function calc_residuals!(ws::ResidualBuffers, model_vec::AbstractModel)
    # Models implement this to compute residuals
end

# Default fallback for passive models (line 105-116)
function calc_residuals!(ws::ResidualBuffers{T, AT},
                        model_vec::StructArray{M},
                        _external::NamedTuple) where {T, AT, M<:AbstractModel}
    # Default: do nothing (passive models like Area, Owner, Zone)
    nothing
end

# Formulation-specific dispatch (line 119-122)
function calc_residuals!(ws::ResidualBuffers{T, AT},
                        model_vec::StructArray{M},
                        external::NamedTuple,
                        formulation::FormulationTrait) where {T, AT, M<:AbstractModel}
    # Forward to 3-argument version for backward compatibility
    calc_residuals!(ws, model_vec, external)
end

# Observation outputs (line 125-150)
function get_output_value(::SystemModel, ::AbstractVector,
                         model_type::Type{<:AbstractModel}, var::Symbol, ::Int)
    error("No get_output_value implementation for model type $model_type and variable $var")
end

# Status field retrieval (line 153-186)
function get_status_field(model_type::Type{<:AbstractModel})
    metadata = model_metadata(model_type)
    return metadata.status_field
end

# Formulation-specific metadata (line 217-249)
function get_metadata_for_formulation(metadata::ModelMetadata, formulation::Type{F})
    # Returns (vars, residuals) for the requested formulation
end

Defined in: src/foundation/format_traits.jl

# Format support check (line 1-10)
abstract type FormatSupport{F} end
struct NoFormatSupport end

function supports_format(model_type::Type{<:AbstractModel},

# Parser interface
function parse_model end

Defined in: src/foundation/formulation_traits.jl

# Formulation support check (line 86-104)
function supports_formulation(::Type{M}, ::Type{F}) where {M<:AbstractModel, F<:FormulationTrait}

4. Centralization Analysis

✅ HIGHLY CENTRALIZED Interface

Evidence:

  1. Single Source of Truth: All interface signatures in foundation/

    • model_metadata() - model_metadata.jl line 45
    • calc_residuals!() - model_metadata.jl line 78
    • get_output_value() - model_metadata.jl line 125
    • supports_format() - format_traits.jl
    • supports_formulation() - formulation_traits.jl

  2. Clear Import Pattern: Models import interface, don't define it

    # src/models/Models.jl
import Powerful: model_metadata, calc_residuals!, get_output_value

  3. Fallback Implementations: Foundation provides sensible defaults

    # line 105-116: Default calc_residuals! does nothing (passive models)

  4. Trait-Based Extension: Uses traits for optional capabilities

    # Format support via traits
supports_format(::Type{PQ}, ::Type{PSSE}) = FormatSupport{PSSE}()

# Formulation support via traits
supports_formulation(::Type{Bus}, ::Type{PowerInjection}) = PowerInjection()
supports_formulation(::Type{Bus}, ::Type{CurrentInjection}) = CurrentInjection()

  5. Formulation System: Models declare support for multiple formulations

    # Models store formulation-specific metadata
metadata.vars_by_formulation[CurrentInjection] = CURRENT_VARS
metadata.residuals_by_formulation[CurrentInjection] = CURRENT_RESIDUALS

6. Comparison to Julia Ecosystem Patterns

Matches SciML Pattern

Your structure:

foundation/  → PowerfulBase.jl (interface)
models/      → Powerful.jl (implementations)
solvers/     → Powerful.jl (algorithms)

SciML structure:

SciMLBase.jl      → Problem types, solve() interface
OrdinaryDiffEq.jl → Concrete ODE solvers
NonlinearSolve.jl → Nonlinear solvers

Matches Tables.jl Pattern

Your trait-based interfaces:

function model_metadata(::Type{M}) where M <: AbstractModel
    # Models implement this to describe their structure
end

function calc_residuals!(ws::ResidualBuffers, model::M) where M
    # Models implement this to compute residuals
end

Tables.jl traits:

Tables.istable(::Type{MyTable}) = true
Tables.rowaccess(::Type{MyTable}) = true
Tables.rows(t::MyTable) = ...

Matches GeoInterface.jl Pattern

Your terminals/connectivity:

const PQ_TERMINALS = (Terminal(:Bus, :i),)
Powerful.get_terminals(::Type{<:PQ}) = PQ_TERMINALS

GeoInterface traits:

GeoInterface.geomtrait(geom::MyGeom) = PointTrait()
GeoInterface.getcoord(::PointTrait, geom, i) = ...

7. Scattering vs Centralization Score

Score: 9.5/10 (Highly Centralized) ✅

Strengths:

  1. ✅ All interface signatures in one place (foundation/model_metadata.jl)
  2. ✅ Abstract type hierarchy clearly organized by concern
  3. ✅ Trait-based extension (no need to touch interface for new models)
  4. ✅ Single import point for model developers (Models.jl)
  5. ✅ Fallback implementations prevent boilerplate
  6. ✅ Documentation as contract (error messages guide implementers)
  7. ✅ Layered architecture (foundation → models → solvers)
  8. ✅ Formulation system enables multiple equation types per model

Minor Scattering:

  1. ⚠️ 4 abstract types in models/ (AbstractBus, AbstractGenerator, AbstractBranch, AbstractTransformer)
    • Acceptable: These are domain concepts, not interface abstractions
  2. ⚠️ 6 abstract types in solvers/ (Algorithm hierarchy)
    • Acceptable: Solver interface separate from model interface

8. Recommendations

For Current Monolithic Structure

Continue as-is ✅ You're already following best practices:

  1. Keep foundation/ as "interface layer documentation"

  2. Add comment headers marking stable API:

    # ============================================================================
# STABLE API (v1.0 candidate) - Do not change signatures
# ============================================================================

  3. Create src/foundation/INTERFACE.md:

    # Core Model Interface

This directory defines the public interface that PowerfulBase.jl would expose.

**Rule**: Files in this directory MUST NOT import from:
- `../models/`
- `../solvers/`
- `../analysis/`

  4. Add interface-only tests:

    @testset "Interface completeness" begin
    # Can a model be defined using only foundation/ exports?
end

For Future Split

When to split (wait for these signals):

  1. ✅ External package requests interface access
  2. ✅ Version 1.0 reached (interface stable)
  3. ✅ Alternative solver implementations emerge
  4. ✅ Compile times problematic (>30s precompilation)

How to split:

  1. Create PowerfulBase.jl with contents from section 5
  2. Add CI test: PowerfulBase has zero deps on Powerful
  3. Powerful.jl depends on and re-exports PowerfulBase.jl
  4. Users see no difference (transparent migration)

9. Recent Architectural Improvements

Formulation Trait System (2025-01)

Addition: FormulationTrait hierarchy enables multiple equation types per model:

  • PowerInjection: Power balance with polar coordinates (θ, V)
  • CurrentInjection: Current balance with rectangular coordinates (Vr, Vi)

Impact:

  • Models declare formulation support via supports_formulation()
  • Metadata stores formulation-specific variables/residuals
  • AddressManager created per-problem, not stored in SystemModel
  • Same model can serve multiple formulation types

Address Manager Decoupling (2025-01)

Change: AddressManager is NO LONGER stored in SystemModel

Rationale:

  • Different formulations have different variable layouts
  • PowerInjection uses (θ, V), CurrentInjection uses (Vr, Vi)
  • AddressManager is formulation-specific, so created during problem setup
  • SystemModel remains formulation-agnostic (pure data)

Impact:

  • ACPowerFlowProblem constructor creates fresh AddressManager
  • setup_with_formulation!(am, sys, formulation) allocates addresses
  • Cleaner separation: data (SystemModel) vs computation (Problem)

Residual Access Modes (2024-12)

Enhancement: SharedRes now supports two modes:

  • :add - Accumulate contributions (default, for power balance)
  • :set - Overwrite accumulated values (for control equations)

Use case: PV generators in CurrentInjection formulation

  • Branches accumulate current flows into bus: SharedRes(:add)
  • PV reads accumulated currents, replaces one with power equation: SharedRes(:set)
  • Requires gather_residuals!() before calc_residuals!() for :set models

10. Conclusion

Your type system is exemplary for a v0.1.0 package.

  • Interface: Centralized in foundation/ ✅
  • Implementation: Cleanly separated in models/ ✅
  • Consumption: Isolated in solvers/ ✅
  • Extension: Trait-based, minimal boilerplate ✅
  • Formulations: Multi-formulation support via traits ✅

You've done the hard work already. When the ecosystem demands it, splitting into PowerfulBase.jl would be a straightforward refactor, not a rewrite.

Until then: Document the interface clearly, mark stable APIs, and let v1.0 emerge naturally. 🎯
